note: Trigger evals: these measure whether the SKILL.md description causes the skill to be invoked, not whether its content is correct. Content accuracy is verified against the stern release tag per ATTRIBUTION.md.
how_to_run: python3 evals/measure_triggers.py 3   # from the repo root
measurement_pitfalls: Run from the repo root. find_project_root()-style helpers walk up from cwd; starting inside a plugin directory resolves to $HOME, where the model name may be rejected and every call fails in ~1s, scoring as a uniform non-trigger.

Do not detect triggering from --include-partial-messages stream deltas. With a thinking-enabled model the Skill tool's input never accumulates there and every query reads as a non-trigger. Parse completed assistant messages instead.

Parallel workers share .claude/commands/, so each run sees every worker's injected copy of the same description under a different random suffix. Match the name prefix, not the run's own id, or genuine triggers that picked a sibling's copy are scored as misses.
